decisions.decision: families.yaml ships with roughly 10-14 entries, not the roadmap's 25-35
decisions.rationale: The corpus supplies six distinct procedure labels and Phase 12 (which grows the corpus) comes after Phase 11, so the 25-35 count and the every-family-traces-to-a-case criterion cannot both hold. Sizing to committed evidence keeps the stated principle literally true. The plan must amend REQUIREMENTS.md and ROADMAP.md accordingly.

decisions.decision: Frequentist-only routing is decided outside dsx/frame/admissibility.py, via a helper in dsx/frame/paradigm.py called from run_checks
decisions.rationale: Making DSX-ADM-* paradigm-independent would draw a CRITICAL block on an honest 'paradigm: bayesian' declaration, making misdeclaration cheaper than telling the truth — the inversion brief D-10 exists to block.

decisions.decision: The new test-name alias table is read by the new adjudicator only; dsx/checks/stats.py and dsx/frame/prereg.py are not rewired
decisions.rationale: ROADMAP SC 2 requires existing specs to behave unchanged. Rewiring either check changes a shipped firing set and can silently invalidate suppressions operators already wrote.

decisions.decision: Estimand axis keyed on a new optional validity_frame.estimand.type field with an ESTIMAND_TYPES vocabulary
decisions.rationale: RESEARCH.md verified that the alternative (analysis.outcome_type + n_groups + paired) fails, because examples/known-bad/weak-identification-mmm-ANALYSIS-SPEC.yaml has no analysis: block at all. estimand: is always required, so it reaches every fixture.

context_notes: The intellectual work for this phase is done and is unusually well grounded — CONTEXT.md carries 29 decisions with file-and-line citations, RESEARCH.md verified the YAML schema by actually round-tripping it through both loader paths, and the citation spine was researched against primary sources with unverified locators honestly marked. What remains is mechanical: turn the rest of that into plans. The three written plans are all foundation work (requirement amendments and doc corrections; the estimand vocabulary; the boundary scanner and paradigm helper) and correctly declare wave 1 with no dependencies. The plans that actually build the adjudicator are the ones missing, and they belong in later waves because they depend on the estimand vocabulary from 11-02 and the paradigm helper from 11-03. One trap RESEARCH.md found and the resuming agent must not lose: the new estimand-type field has to be populated on all nine committed example specs, not just the good fixture, or DSX-ADM-020 fires spuriously at the plan gate and breaks tests/test_known_bad_corpus.py.
